meta.title: Antidepressant pharmacogenomics — Australia-mapped data spine
meta.purpose: Deterministic clinical-fact source for antidepressant PGx decision support, mapped to the Australian context (TGA registration + PBS listing).
meta.scope_statement: Genotype guides METABOLISM, DOSING and SAFETY only. It does NOT predict which antidepressant will treat the depression (efficacy). Decision support, not diagnosis. Clinician in the loop.

guideline_sources.cpic_ssri: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6, CYP2C19, CYP2B6, SLC6A4, HTR2A and Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitor Antidepressants. Bousman et al., Clin Pharmacol Ther 2023;114(1):51-68 (PMID 37032427).
guideline_sources.cpic_tca: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6, CYP2C19 and Tricyclic Antidepressants. Hicks et al., Clin Pharmacol Ther 2017;102(1):37-44 (2016/17 update).
guideline_sources.dpwg: Royal Dutch Pharmacogenetics Working Group (DPWG) recommendations, as encoded by PharmCAT/PharmGKB.
guideline_sources.fda: FDA Table of Pharmacogenetic Associations and product labels.
guideline_sources.pharmcat: Gene-drug coverage cross-checked against PharmCAT Genes & Drugs (pharmcat.clinpgx.org), managed at Stanford/UPenn (NHGRI U24HG013077).

meta.australia_localisation_note: CPIC and DPWG guidelines are the same standards Australia relies on (e.g. the Australian PRESIDE trial was built on CPIC/DPWG). The gene->phenotype->dosing science transfers directly. What is localised here: TGA_registered (is the drug on the ARTG / marketed in Australia) and PBS_listed (is it subsidised). Where a recommendation rests only on an FDA source, the Australian equivalent to check is the TGA Product Information.
meta.verification_required: TGA_registered and PBS_listed values below are indicative and MUST be verified against the live ARTG (tga.gov.au) and PBS Schedule (pbs.gov.au) before clinical or product use, and date-stamped. PBS listings carry formulation/indication restrictions not captured here.

evidence_strength_key.strong_pk_safety: Well-supported gene->metabolism (and for some, safety) association; basis of CPIC dosing guidance.
evidence_strength_key.moderate: CPIC/DPWG recommendation present but optional or based on limited prospective data.
evidence_strength_key.weak_us_label_only: No CPIC/DPWG actionable dosing recommendation; guidance derives from an FDA label only.
evidence_strength_key.none: No actionable CYP-based PGx dosing guidance; effectively genotype-neutral.

meta.phenotype_abbreviations: UM=Ultrarapid, RM=Rapid, NM=Normal, IM=Intermediate, PM=Poor metaboliser

cpic_recommendation.UM: Consider an alternative not predominantly metabolised by CYP2C19 (lower exposure, greater risk of non-response / switching).
cpic_recommendation.RM: Initiate standard dose; if inadequate response, consider an alternative.
cpic_recommendation.IM: Initiate standard starting dose; reduced metabolism may warrant slower titration.
cpic_recommendation.PM: Consider ~50% starting-dose reduction OR an alternative not metabolised by CYP2C19 (increased exposure; QT/adverse-effect risk).

antidepressants.au_notes: Standard first-line SSRI in Australia. TGA dose caps for QT apply independently of genotype.

cpic_recommendation.UM: Avoid; select an alternative not predominantly metabolised by CYP2D6 (risk of poor response).
cpic_recommendation.PM: Avoid; select an alternative, or use a lower dose (increased exposure / adverse effects).

antidepressants.au_notes: Strong CYP2D6 auto-inhibitor (dose-dependent >30 mg/day) — causes phenoconversion of self and co-medications.

cpic_recommendation.UM: Consider an alternative not predominantly metabolised by CYP2D6.
cpic_recommendation.PM: Consider a 25-50% lower starting dose and titrate to response, OR an alternative.

antidepressants.au_notes: Also a CYP1A2/CYP2C19 inhibitor — relevant for drug-interaction phenoconversion of co-medications.

cpic_recommendation.all: No CPIC dosing recommendation (long-acting active metabolite norfluoxetine complicates exposure). FDA label notes higher concentrations in CYP2D6 poor metabolisers.

antidepressants.au_notes: FLAG: genotype guidance is FDA-label only — weaker/US-oriented. Strong CYP2D6 inhibitor; inhibition persists ~weeks after stopping (norfluoxetine half-life).

cpic_recommendation.UM: Consider an alternative not predominantly metabolised by CYP2D6.
cpic_recommendation.PM: OPTIONAL: consider an alternative, or monitor for tolerability (altered venlafaxine:O-desmethylvenlafaxine ratio).

antidepressants.au_notes: FDA Table lists venlafaxine as warranting dose adjustment in CYP2D6 PMs. CPIC recommendation is optional.

cpic_recommendation.UM: Monitor response; consider an alternative if inadequate.

cpic_recommendation.CYP2D6_PM: Avoid (higher adverse-effect risk); if warranted, reduce dose ~50% and use TDM.
cpic_recommendation.CYP2C19_UM: Consider an alternative TCA not metabolised by CYP2C19.

genotype_neutral_options_australia.note: Common antidepressants available in Australia with NO actionable CYP2D6/CYP2C19-based CPIC dosing recommendation. Useful fallbacks when a gene call is low-confidence (e.g. CYP2D6 from a consumer array) or when avoiding a specific enzyme.
